verses.text: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.

xrefs.text: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
What then shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.
For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.

verses.text: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.

xrefs.text: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

verses.text: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.

xrefs.text: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.

verses.text: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.

xrefs.text: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.

verses.text: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.

xrefs.text: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.
“Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.
In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!

For My name will be great among the nations, from where the sun rises to where it sets. In every place, incense and pure offerings will be presented in My name, because My name will be great among the nations,” says the LORD of Hosts.

verses.text: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.

xrefs.text: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?

For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
The LORD sends poverty and wealth; He humbles and He exalts.
He mocks the mockers, but gives grace to the humble.
But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

verses.text: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.

xrefs.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?

Therefore the anger of the LORD burns against His people; His hand is raised against them to strike them down. The mountains quake, and the corpses lie like refuse in the streets. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.

verses.text: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.

xrefs.text: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
